This infrastructure guide bridges the gap by providing a step-by-step solution to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, complete with automatic crypto payment processing and instant file delivery, giving creators in Kenya the freedom to sell their ebooks to anyone, anywhere, without relying on conventional platforms.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The geographic exclusion that creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh face from conventional payment platforms is systemic, not incidental. PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy all operate within the traditional financial system, subject to the same correspondent banking relationships and AML compliance requirements that make international money movement difficult in certain corridors. Blockchain-based payments operate outside this system entirely. A USDT transaction from a buyer in Germany to a seller in Lagos does not pass through any correspondent bank. It does not require a compliance officer to approve the transaction corridor. It settles peer-to-peer, on-chain, in under 60 seconds.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying this infrastructure, you'll need a basic understanding of how to use GitHub or Cloudflare Pages to host your website, and how to set up a NOWPayments account to receive cryptocurrency payments. You'll also need to create a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account to store and deliver your ebooks. Don't worry if you're new to these tools; the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides instant access to all the necessary blueprints and templates to get you started.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages both provide free static site hosting that works identically regardless of where the store operator is located. A store deployed on Cloudflare Pages by a creator in Harare is served from Cloudflare's global edge network — the same infrastructure that serves enterprises in New York. Neither platform imposes geographic restrictions on who can deploy a store or who can access it. Combined with NOWPayments for payment processing and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, this creates a complete commerce infrastructure with zero hosting costs and no geographic restrictions at any layer of the stack.
Deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack gives you complete control over your business and its data.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you're ready to go live and process your first transaction. Simply upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and configure your NOWPayments account to receive payments in your preferred cryptocurrency. With USDT on Tron settling in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, you can start selling your ebooks to international buyers in no time.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your ebook sales grow, you can scale your infrastructure to meet demand by upgrading to a paid plan on GitHub or Cloudflare Pages, or by adding additional features to your NOWPayments account. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, giving you the freedom to focus on creating great content and selling it to a global audience.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
By using free and open-source tools like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages, you can bypass transaction fees and geographic barriers.

If you're in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, or Tanzania, and you're looking for a way to sell digital products to international buyers without relying on traditional payment platforms, this infrastructure guide is for you. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack using free and open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and NOWPayments, you can bypass geographic barriers and transaction fees, and start selling your ebooks to anyone, anywhere. For a complete guide on how to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, or visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information on our products and services.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this infrastructure, follow these steps: Create a GitHub or Cloudflare Pages account to host your website. Set up a NOWPayments account to receive cryptocurrency payments. Create a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account to store and deliver your ebooks. Connect your NOWPayments account to your GitHub or Cloudflare Pages website. Configure your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account to deliver your ebooks automatically upon payment receipt. Upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Configure your NOWPayments account to receive payments in your preferred cryptocurrency.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the minimum amount of cryptocurrency I need to receive a payment?

With NOWPayments, there is no minimum amount of cryptocurrency required to receive a payment. As long as the payment is confirmed on the blockchain, you'll receive the funds in your NOWPayments account.
Can I deliver my ebooks in multiple formats?
Yes, with the use of Cloudflare R2, you can deliver your ebooks in multiple formats, including PDF, EPUB, and MOBI, ensuring that your customers can access their ebooks in their preferred format.
How do I handle refunds and chargebacks?

With NOWPayments, you can easily handle refunds and chargebacks by simply issuing a refund or disputing the charge with your customer. This ensures that your customers are satisfied, and that you're protected from potential losses.
Can I integrate my existing email marketing software with this infrastructure?

Yes, with the use of Zapier or other integration tools, you can easily integrate your existing email marketing software with this infrastructure, ensuring that your customers receive updates and promotions from your business.
How do I track my sales and analytics?

With the use of Google Analytics and NOWPayments, you can easily track your sales and analytics, ensuring that you have a clear picture of your business performance and can make data-driven decisions to grow your business.
